W.note: The 32px pill is the most compact footprint, but the panel toggles instantly with no transition, lists four packages with 10-11px text and only a progress bar rather than a timeline, and every action rebuilds the list so keyboard focus is lost.

X.note: A 48px single-row collapse with a smooth grid-rows open and close, a labeled five-step rail with dates and expected windows, the tracking number in the header, and a well-built exception block with next-step actions, all with inert panel, Escape and focus handling.

Y.note: It rests as a 56px collapsed row with a separate hide control, animates the panel smoothly with visibility hidden when closed, shows a clean timeline with expected tags and an exception box, and keeps focus on the control used, though the tracking number is not shown inside the toast.

Z.note: The multi-package list, segmented filter and monospace full tracking number with a step timeline are strong, but the expanded state is tall, open and close are instant, the whole root is rebuilt with innerHTML so focus drops after each action, and the add-form inputs rely on placeholders alone for labels.
